path.title: pelargir flax flow emulator: one band flow (D = 6: N_res of the band + x = log10(S_gw + C) in its 5 bins)

svg.text: One such flow per 5-bin band (99 for a 0.1 to 10 mHz training set), each trained independently; the emulator's log density is their sum.

path.title: every step's log|Jacobian| is added to log_prob
zero bins: log|dy/dv| (the slab measure), so the mass below log10 C is P(S_gw = 0)

svg.text: context (8): m_mu, m_sigma, r_disk, r_bulge, q_BD,

path.title: Inside one coupling layer (mask m alternates between layers)

svg.text: ReLU after the last hidden layer
per dim: 8 widths, 8 heights, 9 knot slopes

path.title: applied to the dims with m = 0
Dims with m = 1 pass through unchanged and condition the spline; outside [-5, 5] the spline is the identity.
The Jacobian is triangular, so log|det| is the sum of the spline slopes' logs over the transformed dims.

svg.text: distrax MaskedCoupling + RationalQuadraticSpline; weights in float64 (default) or float32; optax Adam.

path.title: log sum_k w_k q(y_k | c) |dy_k/d(N, S)|,
y_k = y(N + u_k, S); 32 Gauss-Legendre u_k

svg.text: Pure jax.jit functions, usable inside an outer

path.title: log_prob runs y to z (inverse spline chain);
sampling runs z to y and undoes the transforms:
N_res = floor(N + u), S_gw = max(10^x - C, 0)
